race.title: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap
race.verdict: BONA FORTUNA has taken really well to all-weather on his last 2 starts and he looks sure to make a bold bid to resume winning ways. He's thereore selected to prove too good for Leading Times , who is 2 from 2 at this course, and Master of My Fate who is very well treated if fit enough after a break. BONA FORTUNA (IRE) LEADING TIMES MASTER OF MY FATE (IRE)
